title: Ladder 17 · Caesar et pīrātae (Caesar and the pirates)
summary: 75 BC, a true story (Plutarch, Suetonius): pirates seize young Caesar off Miletus. Marcus writes from the pirates' island, Lucius from the harbour of Miletus, collecting the ransom Caesar himself raised from 20 to 50 talents. Poems, 'barbarians', a sworn promise. English → Latin, then the Latin twice. Iulia's voice.
